title: Sharḥ Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam
genre: lettrist commentary on Ibn ʿArabī's Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam

date.basis: Colophon on MS Majlis 10196 f. 330a, which states completion and correction; the timeline (p.52) instead says 813/1411. The Majlis copy itself was completed in Shiraz 3 Rabīʿ I 831/22 Dec 1427 and vouched for in the author's hand 28 Ṣafar 832/4 Dec 1428.

place: Not stated for the 814 completion; corrected in Fars (817); read in Herat (820); Majlis copy completed in Shiraz (831); author's note written at Chālū, Tabaristan (832).
occasion: not stated in the entry (the timeline links 813/1411 with a journey to the Hijaz, with a question mark)
manuscript: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 241b-330a; MS Majlis 10082 (511 ff., 835/1432); MS Mishkāt 1294 (839/1435); partial Kastamonu 1233/2.
majlis_folios: ff. 241b-330a (colophon and author's note on f. 330a)
summary: A long, subtle commentary on Ibn ʿArabī's Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam with frequent lettrist explanations and excursuses; it is one of Ibn Turka's four or five major works and is cited by his later R. Ḥurūf and by the Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr.
edition_note: Ed. Muḥsin Bīdārfar, 2 vols., Qom 2000 (Arabic, with Mullā ʿAlī Nūrī's marginalia in the footnotes).
